A Farewell from Covrzy covrzy . Est. — A Farewell Note — An Important Announcement After a meaningful journey, Covrzy is winding down. Every chapter, however cherished, must come to a close. We are writing today to share that Covrzy is officially shutting down its operations — with deep gratitude for everyone who walked this road with us. A note to our clients & partners, Thank you — for believing , for building, and for being there. When we set out to build Covrzy, we imagined a future shaped by trust, simplicity, and the kind of relationships that only come from doing meaningful work together. What followed was nothing short of extraordinary — and that is entirely because of you . To our clients : thank you for placing your confidence in a young idea. You trusted us with something important, and we will carry that responsibility with us long after the lights go out. Every conversation, every renewal, every candid piece of feedback — they shaped us. To our partners : thank you for the collaborations, the late-night problem-solving, the patience during pivots, and the generosity of spirit you showed time and time again. You believed in the mission as much as we did, and your support made the impossible feel routine. While Covrzy as a company is closing its doors, the friendships, the lessons, and the standards we set together will live on. If there is anything we can do for you during this transition — questions, documents, a final conversation — please do reach out. We are here. With gratitude, — The Covrzy Team What we'll carry forward . — three things — i. The people we met The clients who trusted us early, the partners who picked up the phone, the teammates who poured themselves in. The relationships outlast the company. ii. The lessons learned Every product call, every hard conversation, every unexpected turn taught us something we'll carry into whatever comes next. None of it was wasted. iii. The standard we set Care, candour, and craft. The way we tried to show up for you is the way we hope to keep showing up — wherever the road leads from here. Still need to reach us?
